mapper.sql: id, report_id, report_type, report_size, period, creation_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO overload (report_id, report_type, report_size, period, creation_date) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{reportType}, #{reportSize}, #{period}, #{creationDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE overload SET report_id = #{reportId}, report_type = #{reportType}, report_size = #{reportSize}, period = #{period}, creation_date = #{creationDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, report_type, report_size, period, creation_date, max(report_id) AS max_id, count(*) AS count FROM overload WHERE report_type = #{record.type}
SELECT id, report_id, report_type, report_size, period, creation_date, max(report_id) AS max_id, count(*) AS count FROM overload

SELECT id, report_id, report_type, report_size, period, creation_date, max(report_id) AS max_id, count(*) AS count FROM overload WHERE period >= #{record.startTime} AND period <= #{record.endTime} ORDER BY period DESC, report_type ASC
